description: This file defines the StorageReplaceDataWrapper class, which implements the StorageInterface to wrap a configuration storage and allows replacing specific configuration data within a collection.

classes.name: StorageReplaceDataWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps a configuration storage to allow replacing specific configuration data, implementing the StorageInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the wrapper with a storage object and optional collection name.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a configuration item exists, considering replacements.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a configuration item, returning replacement data if available.

methods.name: readMultiple
methods.description: Reads multiple configuration items, applying replacements where applicable.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes configuration data, removing any replacement data for the item.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a configuration item, including any replacement data.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Renames a configuration item, updating replacement data accordingly.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes data using the underlying storage's method.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes raw data using the underlying storage's method.

methods.name: listAll
methods.description: Lists all configuration item names, including replacements.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all configuration items with a given prefix, including replacements.

methods.name: getAllCollectionNames
methods.description: Returns all collection names from the underlying storage.

methods.name: replaceData
methods.description: Replaces the data for a specific configuration object.
